statement.zh: 有界的前段确定历程，前段长度恰好。界给定时归纳即演绎；不给定界时，按最小的界的外推从 2N − 1 起每步都对，与任何外推能做到的一样早：界给出沉默，不给出更早的停息。有限的名命名有意义的切分，不用商。
statement.en: A bounded prefix fixes the course at an exact length. With the bound given, induction is deduction; not given, extrapolation by the least bound is right from 2N − 1 on, as early as any can be: the bound buys silence, not speed. Finite names name the split that makes sense, with no quotient.

laws.zh: 两个周期（Fine–Wilf）：周期为 p + 1、在前 p 步都在 Q 步后回来的历程在每一步都在 Q 步后回来；从 i、i' 起以周期 q + 1、q' + 1 重复的两个历程在 (i + q + 1) + (i' + q') 之前相同，就处处相同。
laws.en: Two periods (Fine–Wilf): a course with period p + 1 that comes back after Q steps at each of its first p steps comes back after Q steps at every step; two courses repeating from i, i′ with periods q + 1, q′ + 1 that agree before (i + q + 1) + (i′ + q′) agree at every step.

laws.zh: 历程至多有 N 个状态（StatesBelow o N：每一时刻与 N 之前的某一时刻是同一状态），恰当它从某步 i 起以某个周期 q + 1 重复，且 i + q + 1 ≤ N。
laws.en: A course has at most N states (StatesBelow o N: every moment is one state with some moment before N) exactly where it repeats from some step i with some period q + 1, i + q + 1 ≤ N.

laws.zh: 至多 N 与至多 N' 个状态的两个历程在 N + N' − 1 之前相同，就处处相同；前段相等恰当历程在其长度之前相同；所以长 N + N' − 1 的前段确定历程。
laws.en: Two courses with at most N and at most N′ states that agree before N + N′ − 1 agree at every step; prefixes are equal exactly where the courses agree before their length; so the prefix before N + N′ − 1 fixes the course.

laws.zh: 给出两个值：对每个 T，一个状态的历程与至多 T + 1 个状态的历程长 T 的前段相同而在 T 不同；对每个 M，两个至多 M + 2 个状态的历程长 M + M + 2 的前段相同而在那里不同。对每一对 M、M′，至多 M + 1 与至多 M′ + 1 个状态的两个历程，长 M + M′ 的前段相同而在第 M + M′ 步不同：长度 N + N′ − 1 对每一对界恰好。
laws.en: Given two values: for every T, a course with one state and one with at most T + 1 share their prefix before T and differ at T; for every M, two courses with at most M + 2 states share their prefix before M + M + 2 and differ there. For every M and M′, a course with at most M + 1 states and one with at most M′ + 1 share their prefix before M + M′ and differ at step M + M′: the length N + N′ − 1 is exact for every pair of bounds.

laws.zh: 至多 N 个状态时，两个时刻是同一状态，恰当其后的值在 N + N − 1 步内相同：状态从有限的前段读出。
laws.en: With at most N states, two moments are one state exactly where what follows them agrees for N + N − 1 steps: the states are read off a finite prefix.

laws.zh: 至多 N 个状态的历程上，N 之内（i + q + 1 ≤ N）、在 N + N − 1 之前的前段上相合的套索 (i, q) 每步都相合；值可判定时，N 之内的套索候选在 N + N − 1 之前不合不出现，就处处不出现，且总有这样的候选：归纳即演绎。
laws.en: On a course with at most N states, a lasso (i, q) within N (i + q + 1 ≤ N) that accords on the prefix before N + N − 1 accords at every step; with values decided, a lasso candidate within N that misses nowhere before N + N − 1 misses nowhere at all, and one always does: induction is deduction.

laws.zh: 给定 N 的外推（withBound N）在 N + N − 1 之前默，之后按第一个在 N 之内、为前段所证实的套索候选提出；在每个至多 N 个状态的历程上，它处处相合，从 N + N − 1 起每步都对。
laws.en: The extrapolation given N (withBound N) stays silent before N + N − 1 and then proposes by the first lasso candidate within N that the prefix bears out; on every course with at most N states it misses nowhere and is right at every step from N + N − 1 on.

laws.zh: 没有外推能总是更早提出：给出两个值，没有外推在每个至多 M + 2 个状态的历程上都处处相合、且在第 M + M + 2 步都提出。
laws.en: None can always propose sooner: given two values, no extrapolation misses nowhere on every course with at most M + 2 states and proposes at step M + M + 2 on each.

laws.zh: withBound 2 对二值否定从第 3 步起每步都对；other 移动每个值时，回答给定 N 之外推的历程超出 N 个状态。
laws.en: withBound 2 is right about the two-valued negation at every step from 3 on; where other moves every value, the course answering the extrapolation given N has more than N states.

laws.zh: 至多 N 个状态且值可判定时，N 之内的套索候选 (a, b)（a ≤ s）在 s 到 s + (N + N − 1) 之前的每步不合不出现，就从 s 起每步不出现；对套索候选的逐除外推从第 N + (N + N − 1) · tri N 步起每步提出且正确；套索历程上有这样的一步。
laws.en: With at most N states and values decided, a lasso candidate (a, b) within N, a ≤ s, missing at no step from s to before s + (N + N − 1) misses at no step from s on; extrapolation by elimination over the lasso candidates proposes and is right at every step from N + (N + N − 1) · tri N on; on a lasso course there is such a step.

laws.zh: 轨道被列表 l 所持时，以 N 为 l 的长度亦然。
laws.en: Where an orbit is held by a list l, the same holds with N the length of l.

laws.zh: 列表 l 在律下封闭时，成员 s、s' 经映射的未来相同，恰当它们在 l.length + l.length − 1 步内相同；l 持有每个配置时，以这一长度的经映射的未来命名（Law.name）有意义，不用商，承载规律，值可判定时判定相同。
laws.en: For a list l closed under the law, members s, s′ have the same future through the map exactly where those futures agree for l.length + l.length − 1 steps; where l holds every configuration, naming by the future through the map of that length (Law.name) makes sense with no quotient, carries the law and, values decided, decides likeness.

laws.zh: Moore 界：确定的律下，N 个成员的列表对律封闭、成员的值判定相同时，两个成员经映射的未来相同，恰当它们在 N − 1 步内相同。在 k + 1 步内相同（Law.AgreeTo）是一条等价链，每一步比前一步细；值不同的成员给出两类，每次严格细分多一类，两两分开的成员不多于列表，所以链在 N − 2 步之内停止细分，律确定，此后不再细分。不判定时，处处相同不被否证。对每个 N ≥ 2 恰好：N 个位置的路径走到停住的最后一个，映射只取是否到了最后，前两个位置在 N − 2 步内相同而在下一步不同。值已定、至多 N 个状态的历史的两个时刻，恰在 N − 1 步内相同时是同一状态。
laws.en: Moore's bound: under a determined law on a list of N members closed under it, with the members' values compared decidedly, two members have the same future through the map exactly where they agree for N − 1 steps. Agreeing for k + 1 steps (Law.AgreeTo) is a chain of equivalences, each finer than the one before; members with different values make two classes, each strict refinement adds one, and members pairwise apart are no more than the list, so the chain stops refining within N − 2 steps and, the law being determined, never refines again. With no decision, that they agree everywhere is refuted by nothing. Exact for every N ≥ 2: on a path of N positions to a last one that stays, the map taking only whether the last is reached, the first two positions agree for N − 2 steps and differ at the next. Two moments of a history with at most N states and decided values are one state exactly where they agree for N − 1 steps.

laws.zh: Moore 界不加前提：确定的律下，N 个成员的列表对律封闭时，两个成员经映射的未来相同，恰当它们在 N − 1 步内相同，不判定任何值。判定的是位置，不是值：律在列表的位置上读出（Law.orbit_memberAt；有限多个存在一并选出，不用选择公理），位置的相同是已定的；把前段中的一致在每一步所连的两个位置逐对合并（Law.merge、Law.joinOrbits），得到位置的一个标记，每个标记只有一个值（Law.joinOrbits_sound）；这个标记在 N − 1 步内一致，值已定的 Moore 界对它成立，再回到值。至多 N 个状态的历史的两个时刻，恰在 N − 1 步内相同时是同一状态，同样不加前提。
laws.en: Moore's bound with no premise: under a determined law on a list of N members closed under it, two members have the same future through the map exactly where they agree for N − 1 steps, with no value compared decidedly. What is decided is the positions, not the values: the law is read on the positions of the list (Law.orbit_memberAt; finitely many existences chosen together, with no axiom of choice), whose equality is decided; joining, pair by pair, the two positions the prefix's agreement joins at each step (Law.merge, Law.joinOrbits) gives a labelling of the positions whose labels have one value each (Law.joinOrbits_sound); the labelling agrees for N − 1 steps, Moore's bound with decided values holds for it, and it carries over to the values. Two moments of a history with at most N states are one state exactly where they agree for N − 1 steps, with no premise too.

laws.zh: 停息之步不需要界：按最小的界的外推（leastBound），不被给予界，在前段于其内证实某个套索候选的最小的界中，按第一个被证实的候选提出（leastFit）；它在至多 N 个状态的每个历史上从 N + N − 1 起每步都对，对每个 N（leastBound_exact）：所找到的候选在真实的界之内，因为真实的候选被证实，而 N 之内、在 N + N − 1 之前被证实的候选处处相合。给定两个值，没有外推（给定界与否）在每个至多 M + 2 个状态的历史上于第 M + M + 2 步都对（rest_earliest），所以 N + N − 1 是对每个外推最优的停息之步，给定界不改变它。界给出的是沉默：没有外推既在每个一个状态的历史上于第 1 步都对，又在每个两个状态的历史上处处相合（rest_without_bound_missed）；给定界的外推在 N + N − 1 之前默而处处相合（第七条规律）。
laws.en: The rest step needs no bound: the extrapolation by the least bound (leastBound), given no bound, proposes by the first lasso candidate the prefix bears out within the least bound within which one is (leastFit); it is right at every step from N + N − 1 on of every history with at most N states, for every N (leastBound_exact): what it finds is within the true bound, since the true candidate is borne out, and a candidate within N borne out before N + N − 1 accords everywhere. Given two values, no extrapolation, given the bound or not, is right at step M + M + 2 on every history with at most M + 2 states (rest_earliest), so N + N − 1 is the optimal rest step for every extrapolation, and being given the bound does not move it. What the bound buys is silence: no extrapolation is both right at step 1 on every history with one state and missing at no step of every history with two states (rest_without_bound_missed); the extrapolation given the bound stays silent before N + N − 1 and misses nowhere (the seventh law).

laws.zh: 逐除外推的停息之步是立方阶的：在 N = 2m + 3 个位置的环上的二值否定（oddCycle，至多 N 个状态）上，它在第 (N³ − N)/4 步不合（byElimination_missed_late），周期 N 之前每个偶数位移花去整整一圈；所以在至多 N 个状态的二值历史上，(N³ − N)/4 之前没有一步使它处处停息（byElimination_rest_cubic）。
laws.en: Extrapolation by elimination rests at a cubic step: on the two-valued negation along a cycle of N = 2m + 3 places (oddCycle), with at most N states, it misses at step (N³ − N)/4 (byElimination_missed_late), each even shift before the period N taking a whole turn; so no step before (N³ − N)/4 bounds its rest on every two-valued history with at most N states (byElimination_rest_cubic).

hypotheses.zh: 不加公理；除了状态数的界不加前提：界写在每条定理之中（StatesBelow o N，或世界被长度为 N 的列表持有）。
hypotheses.en: No axiom; no premise beyond the bound on states, written into each theorem (StatesBelow o N, or a world held by a list of length N).

hypotheses.zh: 外推与按名判定相同要经映射的值可判定（DecidableEq O、DecidableEq R），即 learning-by-refutation 的“值可判定”；按最小的界的外推（leastBound）亦然；bounded_agree、lasso_of_fits、Law.name_identifiesAlike、rest_earliest 与 rest_without_bound_missed 不要。第十六条规律陈述在两个值（Bool）上，值可判定。
hypotheses.en: The extrapolation and deciding likeness by names need the values through the map decided (DecidableEq O, DecidableEq R), the ‘values decided’ of learning-by-refutation; so does the extrapolation by the least bound (leastBound); bounded_agree, lasso_of_fits, Law.name_identifiesAlike, rest_earliest and rest_without_bound_missed do not. The sixteenth law is stated on two values (Bool), which are decided.

hypotheses.zh: 只陈述确定的律与单个经映射的历程；有分支的框架与概率没有陈述。
hypotheses.en: Only determined laws and single courses through a map are stated; branching frames and probabilities are not.

hypotheses.zh: Moore 界以类计的形式（Law.sameFuture_iff_classes、Identification.sameAhead_iff_classes）要成员的值两两判定相同（对列表中的每一对，Decided，不要判定程序）；Law.sameFuture_iff_within 与 Identification.sameAhead_iff_within 不要：它们判定位置（Nat 的相等），不判定值。Law.sameFuture_classes_unrefuted 不要，只说处处相同不被否证。
hypotheses.en: Moore's bound in its counting form (Law.sameFuture_iff_classes, Identification.sameAhead_iff_classes) needs the members' values compared decidedly (Decided for each pair of the list, no decision procedure); Law.sameFuture_iff_within and Identification.sameAhead_iff_within do not: they decide positions (equality in Nat), not values. Law.sameFuture_classes_unrefuted does not, and states only that agreeing everywhere is refuted by nothing.

does_not_show.zh: 界必须成立（历程至多有 N 个状态）；外推不必被给予它（第十五条规律），但没有界时没有前段确定下一个值。
does_not_show.en: The bound must hold (the course has at most N states); the extrapolation need not be given it (the fifteenth law), but with no bound no prefix fixes the next value.

does_not_show.zh: 逐除外推的确切停息之步没有表明：对奇数 N 它在 (N³ − N)/4 之后（第十六条规律），并至多是 N + (2N − 1)·tri N（第十条规律），所以是立方阶；对至多 N 个状态的二值历史（N ≤ 17）与三值历史（N ≤ 9）的穷举，找到奇数 N ≥ 3 的最坏停息之步是 (N³ − N)/4 + 3，这是计算，不是证明。对每个外推最优的是 2N − 1（第十五条规律）。
does_not_show.en: The exact rest step of extrapolation by elimination is not shown: for odd N it comes after (N³ − N)/4 (the sixteenth law) and is at most N + (2N − 1)·tri N (the tenth law), so it is cubic; exhaustive search over two-valued histories with at most N states (N ≤ 17) and three-valued ones (N ≤ 9) finds the worst rest step (N³ − N)/4 + 3 for odd N ≥ 3, a computation, not a proof. The optimum over extrapolations is 2N − 1 (the fifteenth law).

detail.zh: prefix_short：一个状态的历程与 T + 1 个状态的历程有相同的长 T 的前段而在 T 不同；prefix_short_twice：两个 M + 2 个状态的历程（每 M + 2 步与每 M + 1 步标记一次）有相同的长 M + M + 2 的前段而在那里不同；bounded_agree_exact：对每一对 M、M′，以周期 M + 1 标记、标记落在第 M + M′ 步的历程，与在第 M′ 步之前随它、之后不标记的历程，有相同的长 M + M′ 的前段而在那里不同；answer_exceeds_bound：回答给定 N 之外推的历程超出 N 个状态；Law.sameFuture_classes_exact：对每个 M，M + 2 个位置走到停住的最后一个、映射只取是否到了最后的路径上，前两个位置在 M 步内相同而在第 M 步不同；byElimination_missed_late：在 N = 2m + 3 个位置的环上的二值否定上，逐除外推在第 (N³ − N)/4 步不合。
detail.en: prefix_short: a course with one state and one with T + 1 share their prefix before T and differ at T; prefix_short_twice: two courses with M + 2 states (marking every M + 2 and every M + 1 steps) share their prefix before M + M + 2 and differ there; bounded_agree_exact: for every M and M′, the course marking one step in every M + 1, with a mark at M + M′, and the course following it before M′ and unmarked from then on share their prefix before M + M′ and differ there; answer_exceeds_bound: the course answering the extrapolation given N exceeds N states; Law.sameFuture_classes_exact: for every M, on the path of M + 2 positions to a last one that stays, the map taking only whether the last is reached, the first two positions agree for M steps and differ at step M; byElimination_missed_late: on the two-valued negation along a cycle of N = 2m + 3 places extrapolation by elimination misses at step (N³ − N)/4.

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-12 的推测“the full "truth" can be derived, situationally, including the cognition/controller part”与其后的“keep prove to the deepest … for the open questions, if they need to be answered to move forward, answer them”：这里回答 Description、Diagonal 与 Context 留下的后两个开放问题：从有限的前段推出律，以及不加公理命名有意义的切分的类。learning-by-refutation 给出不用界的一面（没有前段确定下一个值；外推停息这一点不能被否证）；这里给出界给定的一面与恰好的边界，并给出未给定界的外推停息之步（由界给出，外推的前段不表明它）。已知的结果：Fine 与 Wilf（1965）的两个周期定理，Moore（1956）的有限实验，Gold（1967）的极限中的辨识；这里在核心中不用公理重证并连成一体。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用，DELEGATED-CHOICES D34；有限的名由 Ren 2026-10-16 取作类比，“take 2”：定理是有界时类有有限的名，“名可名”只是类比）：有限的前段是一个投影，界使它对历程不失去什么；控制者在有界的世界之内，只有回答它的世界使它落空，而那超出界；有界时类的名是它的有限的未来；给定界与未给定界的差别在何时对与能否知道已对，不在最后是否对。Ren 2026-10-15 未把“按情境就是界”取为自己的（“not sure what's the reading 1, but reality is always situational”）；这一读法的限定见 identification-where-runs-part 与 typicality-by-counting。
correspondence.en: Ren's speculation on 12 October 2026, ‘the full "truth" can be derived, situationally, including the cognition/controller part’, and the later ‘keep prove to the deepest … for the open questions, if they need to be answered to move forward, answer them’: this answers the last two questions Description, Diagonal and Context left open, deriving the law from a finite prefix and naming with no axiom the classes of the split that makes sense. Extrapolation by elimination gives the side with no bound (no prefix fixes the next value; the extrapolation's coming to rest is unrefuted); this gives the side with the bound given, its exact boundary, and the step by which the extrapolation not given the bound rests, which the bound gives and the extrapolation's prefix does not show. Known results: Fine and Wilf's two periods (1965), Moore's finite experiments (1956), Gold's identification in the limit (1967), here reproved in the core with no axiom and connected. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation, DELEGATED-CHOICES D34; the finite name taken by Ren on 16 October 2026 as an analogy, “take 2”: the theorem is that within a bound kinds have finite names, and 名可名 is an analogy only): a finite prefix is a projection, which the bound makes lose nothing of the course; the controller is inside the bounded world, and only a world answering it defeats it, which exceeds the bound; with a bound, a class's name is its finite future; being given the bound and not being given it differ in when the extrapolation is right and whether it can know it is, not in whether it ends right. Ren, 15 October 2026, did not take ‘situationally means the bound’ as theirs (“not sure what's the reading 1, but reality is always situational”); the reading's qualification is in identification-where-runs-part and typicality-by-counting.

detail.zh: 复用 Learning.Lasso、lasso_of_held、lasso、lasso_claims、lasso_accords、Accords、MissesAt、prefixOf、back_prefix、back_made、holdFrom、lassoNext 与 diagonal_unrested：界给定时补上它在界未知时的结果；复用逐除外推的 byElimination、lassos、index 及其引理与 lasso_byElimination_bounded，给出它的停息之步。
detail.en: Reuses Learning.Lasso, lasso_of_held, lasso, lasso_claims, lasso_accords, Accords, MissesAt, prefixOf, back_prefix, back_made, holdFrom, lassoNext and diagonal_unrested: it completes, with the bound given, what that record states with the bound unknown; reuses extrapolation by elimination (byElimination, lassos, index and its lemmas, lasso_byElimination_bounded) to state the step at which it rests.

output.zh: 套索、前段、不合与回答的历程；逐除外推及其不合之界。
output.en: Lassos, prefixes, misses and the answering course; extrapolation by elimination and its bound on misses.

input.zh: 有界的前段确定历程；给定界的外推；未给定界的外推的停息之步。
input.en: A bounded prefix fixes the course; the extrapolation given the bound; the step at which the extrapolation not given it rests.

detail.zh: 复用 SameAhead、StatesBelow、shared_below、statesBelow_of_same、lasso_iff_sameAhead 与 Negation：状态的界就是套索的界。
detail.en: Reuses SameAhead, StatesBelow, shared_below, statesBelow_of_same, lasso_iff_sameAhead and Negation: the bound on states is the bound on the lasso.

detail.zh: 复用 IdentifiesAlike、Law.frameBy、Law.SameFuture、Law.alike_iff_sameFuture 与 Law.IdentifiesAlike.carries：有限的名是有意义的切分。

input.zh: 余数与套索世界的位置。
input.en: Remainders and the lasso world's positions.

detail.zh: 那里从内部不能同时持有每个读法；这里有界的历程的律可以推出，回答自己之外推的世界超出界。
detail.en: There, no family of readings within holds every reading at once; here, a bounded course's law is derived, and a world answering its own extrapolation exceeds the bound.

detail.zh: 推广恰在归并之处；这里界使有限的数据确定整个历程。
detail.en: Generalization is exactly where it lumps; here the bound makes finite data fix the whole course.

detail.zh: 其“学习”一项说逐除外推停息这一点不能被否证；held_byElimination_rests 给出这一步，是列表长度的函数，外推自己没有它。
detail.en: Its learning clause says that extrapolation by elimination's coming to rest is unrefuted; held_byElimination_rests states the step, a function of the list's length, which the extrapolation does not have.

detail.zh: 这里对确定的律陈述；那里对每个过程，恰在运行不分开之处，确定的律是实例。
detail.en: Here for determined laws; there for every process, exactly where its runs do not part, determined laws being the instance.

history.en: 14 October 2026, migrated to schema 2 (item F of the open-issues plan: the migration of the 45 schema-1 records with the most lint findings; Ren: “please, do all”, relayed by the integrating session): the long title became the statement and the new title is “Identification where bounded”; the claim became 12 laws; the limitations went to does-not-show items, the hypotheses and standard boundaries; the evidence became one paragraph. Law 6 states a condition bounded_induction carries that the old claim left to context, “within N” (within: i + q + 1 ≤ N); law 10 says “values decided”, which unrefuted_persists and learner_rests carry (DecidableEq O) and the old text stated only in the hypotheses, for the learner; law 2 writes out the definition of StatesBelow (every moment is one state with some moment before N). “No Lean axiom is used”, with no ethical premise among the hypotheses, cites the standard boundary no-ethical-premise. Work-item numbers became names: P70, the source of StatesBelow in the claim, is carried by the dependency the-split-that-makes-sense; in the hypotheses “P73's ‘values decided’” became that of learning-by-refutation; in the correspondence “P83 (work board)” and the times of Ren's messages, 05:12 and 06:01, are in this record's first history note, “P70–P72 left open” became what Description, Diagonal and Context left open, P73 became learning-by-refutation, and “See §97 of the integration note” joined the evidence (author counterreview in the integration note); in next_delta P69's Alike and P76's tests became Alike of Becoming.Unfolding and the tests of Becoming.Histories, and “(by whichever lands second)”, an arrangement of the work, is kept here. The theorem, module and audit counts of the evidence and the periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z stay in the receipts and the last text_versions entry. No law, premise, status, proof binding or source hash changed. Every earlier sentence is mapped in the migration table [identification-where-bounded.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/identification-where-bounded.md); the exact earlier record is the last text_versions entry.
